title: Air-Gapped Field Triage
description: Laptop-scale, zero-egress profile for on-scene triage. Same core as MinimalForensics plus explicit partitioning and hash-first integrity so a 16 GB workstation stays inside the PERFORMANCE_GUIDE comfort zone.
mission: Let an ICAC/field examiner produce partitioned, hash-verified CASE graphs with no network and no CAC T-Box load.

File.notes: Hash every file at acquisition. Partition the graph per volume or per app, not by arbitrary object count.

recipe_skeleton.summary: One focused graph per forensic boundary; hash everything; never call the network.
steps: Create one CASEGraph per volume, app, or device — not one giant graph.
Record Tool + InvestigativeAction for the triage collector.
Emit File/Device/RasterPicture observables with required Facet sets.
Call estimate_triples() before serialize; stay under laptop RAM guidance.
Write JSON-LD locally; validate offline with case-utils.
